title: Satheesan’s ‘refusal’ to meet KSU president fuels slugfest in Congress
description: KPCC spokesperson V.R. Anoop launches broadside against Chief Minister. He says in a social media post that the courtesy shown to Hindu Aikya Vedi’s K.P. Sasikala and R.V. Babu could have been extended to KPCC general secretary P.M. Niyas and KSU president Aloshious Xavier
